statement: An actual c-equivariant nonlinear presentation of the local three-primary Galois source over its fixed rank-two free quotient, with the change of splitting, complete local section equation and central obstruction map.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The source is the actual local D and the quotient is the fixed arithmetic P. Every generator correction is proved to preserve this quotient and c.
The relative Fox filtration proves gr(K prime)=J prime for the induced lower-three-central filtration; direct Hall/Magnus independence supplies the integral proof.
Horizontal corrections lie in K, vertical corrections in K prime. Jacobi and horizontal induction prove surjectivity in every degree; finite checks corroborate the all-degree proof.
The new splitting j1 is compared to E75 j0 by the actual R3-valued cocycle h and its inverse coordinate formula. The final vertical generators retain their E75 relative abelian classes.
The full local section coordinates are pairs(u,a) with J(uT(a)u inverse a^-7)=uT(a)u inverse a^-7, modulo the exact W^c action. Actual geometric T and J are retained.

The oriented defect omega maps to omega/2 in the local invariant coordinate. Its changes and all nonempty central fibers are explicit. The proof constructs the actual source words by a convergent process; it does not print a guessed arithmetic relator.
The global remaining evaluations in E23 are not declared solved.
